hints: It is the heap Dijkstra from unit 05 with one change: the key you push is the edge cost alone, not dist[u] + cost.
Lazy deletion again: a vertex may be in the heap several times with different keys. The first time it comes out is the cheapest; skip it on every later pop with 'if (inTree[u]) continue;'.
Count how many vertices actually joined. Fewer than n means disconnected.
source: DSA theory: 'implementation of Prim's and Dijkstra's algorithms using priority queues'
title: Prim with a priority queue
